name: tvspy
description: TVSPY - Web Application to Monitor TVHeadend in Real Time

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix tvspy-backend" "npm run dev --prefix tvspy-frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start --prefix tvspy-backend" "npm run preview --prefix tvspy-frontend"
